name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-vscode
description: DeepSeek Harness web UI inside a VS Code webview

dsh.autoOpen.description: Open the DeepSeek Harness panel automatically when a window with a file workspace folder starts. A window with no such folder never opens one.

enumDescriptions: The runtime may not modify files; writes are refused unless the session is granted a wider mode.
The runtime may modify files under the opened project folder and permitted temporary directories.
The runtime may modify any file the extension host can reach.
dsh.permissionMode.description: File-effect mode the extension launches the runtime with, passed as DSH_PERMISSION_MODE. It sets the process fallback; a permission preset a user picks in the UI still wins for the sessions it applies to.

dsh.executablePath.description: Absolute path to a dsh executable. Takes precedence over every other candidate.

enumDescriptions: Prefer a workspace or PATH dsh, then fall back to the bundled runtime.
Use only a workspace or PATH dsh; never fall back to the bundled runtime.
Use only the runtime bundled with this extension.
dsh.runtime.description: Which dsh runtime the extension launches.

dsh.readinessTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the dsh web readiness line before giving up. The first boot of a fresh profile installs packages and is slow.
